metadata_cpu_method.method: Uniform accrual within approximately one-second metadata intervals, apportioned by completed graph overlap; user/system core time separate.

units.native_prefill_and_decode_wall_partition: Wall seconds: exposed wait + management + residual; prefill residual is derived, never direct kernel time.
units.native_cpu: CPU core-seconds, separately measured; may exceed wall. Decode cpu_s_tok is weighted by generated tokens.
units.native_overlap_io: Summed positioned-read-loop lane seconds, not wall-additive; excludes earlier bounce setup and following memcpy.
units.trace_io: Summed full FileReader.read outer elapsed per lane, including staging/setup/copy; not isolated copy CPU and not wall-additive.
units.read_bytes: Application logical requested/aligned completed bytes, not physical NAND traffic.
units.cache: Lookup-count hits; batch-staged prefill requests are not all prompt-token/expert assignments.
units.perf: Estimated user CPU core-seconds from owned-process leaf samples, excluding kernel/system CPU and sleep.
units.metadata: Per-thread counters apportioned by one-second frame overlap; approximate, may miss exiting-thread tail CPU.
units.host_per_core: Host busy percentage excluding idle/iowait and including other processes, not owned-thread residency.

limitations: Graph versus native wall boundaries are retained, not forcibly equated.
Native CPU is core time; wall residual is not directly timed compute.
No new model/benchmark/perf command is executed by this analyzer.
Profiler categories match vec-dot prefixes including F32/BF16/F16 and inlined unpack; no tensor binding or instruction split.
Phase1 requested phase counters reconcile, but pure kernel wall and directly movable dense/attention wall remain unmeasured. CPU core-seconds and wall residual cannot substitute for those quantities.
The previously used >50% total direct-compute threshold was an operational interpretation, not the user requirement that prefill compute dominate; it is not used to skip GPU feasibility here.
Conditional IO/CPU scenarios are arithmetic illustrations, not expected gains, upper bounds under all coupled dynamics, or authorization to tune.
Native timing scopes/CPU categories remain distinct and nonadditive. Matching read/token volume does not establish whole-output byte identity or matched historical machine state.
The actual serializer-updated server 801d differs from instrumented base server b189; nested telemetry source/build proof retained; base CLI and engine objects unchanged.
curation: Allowlisted numeric counters, fixed labels, known function basenames and SHA256 identities only; excludes prompts, outputs, private paths, PIDs, addresses, auth and raw samples.
cpu_symbol_normalization: Known ggml C++ template/clone symbols grouped by plain ggml function basename; template arguments, addresses, offsets and arbitrary strings excluded.

historical_comparison_unmatched.interpretation: Same decode bytes and token count strengthen numeric comparison, but CPU core-time itself changed about 2.15x while mean occupied cores stayed similar. This is not solely an SSD-cache or instrumentation/software gain; cause is unestablished without matched historical frequency/thermal state.

provisional_phase2_options.mechanism: Reduce currently exposed wait; summed lane time and raw bandwidth gap are not directly removable wall.
provisional_phase2_options.conditional_assumption: Unhidden wait scales with sequential reference service ratio, other costs unchanged; unproven, not expected gain.

provisional_phase2_options.candidate: Decode4 versus Decode6 after selected I/O policy fixed
provisional_phase2_options.conditional_assumption: All decode scales linearly with extra CPU threads; false for wait/serial components, so not a prediction.

provisional_phase2_options.candidate: Cache residency/hot pins only after cheap scheduling controls
provisional_phase2_options.reason: Miss fractions are not bytes or time; batch expert union, eviction displacement and admission need separate work.

provisional_phase2_options.candidate: Bounded GPU dense/attention feasibility when implementation support and measured movable work warrant it
provisional_phase2_options.reason: Prefill dominant kernel CPU and largest residual justify examining feasibility; no invented >50% total threshold. Exact CPU-expert/backend handoff, transfer cost, numerical gates and RAM admission remain unknown.
